sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The podcast 20,000 Hertz tells stories about the world's most recognizable and interesting sounds.
sentences.zh: 播客《20,000赫兹》讲述了世界上最易辨识、最有趣的各种声音背后的故事。

sentences.en: It is a great show that you should definitely subscribe to,
sentences.zh: 这是一档非常棒的节目，你绝对应该订阅，

sentences.en: and I'm pleased to present one of their episodes here today.
sentences.zh: 今天我很高兴能在这里为大家呈现他们的一期节目。

sentences.en: It's all about these sounds, which almost need no introduction.
sentences.zh: 这期节目讲的正是这些几乎无需介绍的声音。

sentences.en: From 20,000 Hertz, here is Dallas Taylor.
sentences.zh: 来自《20,000赫兹》，这位是达拉斯·泰勒。

sentences.en: If you watched cartoons as a kid, you probably knew instantly that the sound you just heard was from Looney Tunes.
sentences.zh: 如果你小时候看过动画片，你可能立刻就能听出刚才那个声音来自《乐一通》。

sentences.en: You probably also know that sound meant Wile E.
sentences.zh: 你也可能知道那个声音意味着威利狼

sentences.en: Coyote failed to catch the Roadrunner.
sentences.zh: 又一次没能抓住歪嘴鸟。

sentences.en: Again.
sentences.zh: 又一次。

sentences.en: It's pretty crazy how we can fill in the whole scene based solely on the sound effects,
sentences.zh: 仅凭音效就能脑补出整个场景，这真是太神奇了，

sentences.en: even without a single meep-meep from the Roadrunner.
sentences.zh: 哪怕歪嘴鸟连一声“哔哔”都没叫。

sentences.en: Wile E.
sentences.zh: 威利狼

sentences.en: Coyote started falling off cliffs in 1949,
sentences.zh: 从1949年就开始从悬崖上摔下来了，

sentences.en: yet we still hear that falling sound effect in modern cartoons, like Teen Titans.
sentences.zh: 但我们至今还能在现代动画片（比如《少年泰坦》）中听到那种坠落音效。

sentences.en: I wouldn't stand there if I were you.
sentences.zh: 如果我是你，我就不会站在那儿。

sentences.en: Here it is in Justice League action.
sentences.zh: 在《正义联盟行动》里也能听到。

sentences.en: How do you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: It defies the laws of physics.
sentences.zh: 这简直违背了物理定律。

sentences.en: And here it is even in Family Guy.
sentences.zh: 甚至在《恶搞之家》里也有它。

sentences.en: It's been almost 70 years since the first Wile E.
sentences.zh: 距离第一部威利狼

sentences.en: Coyote cartoon,
sentences.zh: 动画片播出已经快70年了，

sentences.en: and that sound, along with many other cartoon sounds, remains constant.
sentences.zh: 而那个声音，连同许多其他动画音效，依然经久不变。

sentences.en: The beauty and the joy of cartoon animation is that the characters do not have to obey the laws of physics.
sentences.zh: 动画片的魅力和乐趣在于，角色不需要遵守物理定律。

sentences.en: They also don't have to obey the laws of logic.
sentences.zh: 他们也不需要遵守逻辑定律。

sentences.en: And therefore, sound doesn't have to obey those laws either.
sentences.zh: 因此，声音也不必遵守这些定律。

sentences.en: That's Mark Mangini, an Oscar-winning sound designer who works with the Formosa Group.
sentences.zh: 那是马克·曼吉尼，一位与福尔摩沙集团合作的奥斯卡获奖音效设计师。

sentences.en: I don't very often get to talk about my early days in cartoons.
sentences.zh: 我很少有机会谈论我早年制作动画片的经历。

sentences.en: Mark doesn't get a lot of questions about cartoons because he has an impressive resume designing sounds for Hollywood blockbusters.
sentences.zh: 马克很少被问及动画片，因为他在为好莱坞大片设计音效方面有着令人印象深刻的履历。

sentences.en: I've worked on 142 live-action films, most recently Blade Runner 2049,
sentences.zh: 我参与过142部真人电影的制作，最近的有《银翼杀手2049》，

sentences.en: Mad Max Fury Road, which I won an Oscar for and I'm very proud of,
sentences.zh: 还有《疯狂的麦克斯4：狂暴之路》，我凭此获得了奥斯卡奖，对此我深感自豪，

sentences.en: Warrior, Gremlins, Four Star Treks, A Die Hard, A Lethal Weapon, The Green Mile.
sentences.zh: 以及《勇士》、《小魔怪》、《星际迷航》系列四部、《虎胆龙威》、《致命武器》、《绿里奇迹》。

sentences.en: But before Mark did sound for films, he worked for one of the most famous cartoon studios in the world.
sentences.zh: 但在马克为电影制作音效之前，他曾效力于世界上最著名的动画工作室之一。

sentences.en: My first job in sound was at Hanna-Barbera Studios in their sound department.
sentences.zh: 我的第一份音效工作是在汉纳-巴伯拉工作室的音效部门。

sentences.en: I started as a track reader, which is a subset of sound editing where you're charged with transcribing the recordings of the voices
sentences.zh: 我最初是一名音轨阅读员，这是音效剪辑的一个分支，负责转录录音中的人声，

sentences.en: so that the animators know when to open and close the mouths of the characters.
sentences.zh: 这样动画师就能知道什么时候该让角色张嘴和闭嘴。

sentences.en: Just keep your eye on the ball, Bonnie boy.
sentences.zh: 盯紧球，邦尼小子。

sentences.en: That led to subsequent promotions to becoming a sound effects editor in that department at Hanna-Barbera
sentences.zh: 这让我随后获得了晋升，成为了汉纳-巴伯拉部门的音效剪辑师，

sentences.en: and an apprenticeship with a number of really amazingly gifted sound editors.
sentences.zh: 并师从多位非常有天赋的音效剪辑大师。

sentences.en: Back then, this was 1976, I didn't know anyone who was called a sound designer,
sentences.zh: 那时是1976年，我还没听说过谁被称为“音效设计师”，

sentences.en: but I would argue that everything that we were doing at Hanna-Barbera was every bit as designed
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们在汉纳-巴伯拉所做的一切，其设计感丝毫不亚于

sentences.en: as maybe something more profound that was being heard in a motion picture.
sentences.zh: 电影中那些听起来更深奥的东西。

sentences.en: Mark worked on some of Hanna-Barbera's most famous cartoons.
sentences.zh: 马克参与制作了一些汉纳-巴伯拉最著名的动画片。

sentences.en: The Flintstones.
sentences.zh: 《摩登原始人》。

sentences.en: Some Huckleberry Hounds.
sentences.zh: 一些《哈克猎犬》。

sentences.en: A whole raft of Scooby-Doo's.
sentences.zh: 还有一大堆《史酷比》。

sentences.en: Scooby-Doo!
sentences.zh: 史酷比！

sentences.en: The Super Friends.
sentences.zh: 《超级朋友》。

sentences.en: Their mission to fight injustice, to right that which is wrong, and to serve all mankind.
sentences.zh: 他们的使命是打击不公，纠正错误，服务全人类。

sentences.en: And my personal favorite because it starred Mel Blanc, Captain Caveman.
sentences.zh: 还有我个人的最爱，因为梅尔·布兰克参与了配音——《洞穴人队长》。

sentences.en: Long before Mark worked for Hanna-Barbera, and even before Wile E.
sentences.zh: 在马克为汉纳-巴伯拉工作很久之前，甚至在威利狼

sentences.en: Coyote was falling off cliffs,
sentences.zh: 从悬崖上摔下来之前，

sentences.en: Walt Disney made history with Steamboat Willie in 1928.
sentences.zh: 华特·迪士尼在1928年凭借《威利号汽船》创造了历史。

sentences.en: This was the first cartoon with synchronized picture and sound.
sentences.zh: 这是第一部画面与声音同步的动画片。

sentences.en: Walt and Roy and Ub Iwerks themselves would be the sound effects guys in their live orchestral recording sessions
sentences.zh: 华特、罗伊和乌布·伊沃克斯本人就是他们现场管弦乐录音环节的音效师，

sentences.en: for those early Steamboat Willie's.
sentences.zh: 为早期的《威利号汽船》配音。

sentences.en: In the early days, before there was multi-track recording or mixing,
sentences.zh: 在早期，还没有多轨录音或混音技术，

sentences.en: you had to perform the sound effects live with the orchestra in one straight pass.
sentences.zh: 你必须在管弦乐队录音时，一次性现场完成音效表演。

sentences.en: So these sound effects guys had to assemble props, put them in front of microphones,
sentences.zh: 所以这些音效师必须准备好道具，放在麦克风前，

sentences.en: and perform anything that they could acoustically live and in sync with the orchestra.
sentences.zh: 并尽可能用声学方式现场表演，与管弦乐队同步。

sentences.en: Music and sound effects had to be performed at the same time in the same space.
sentences.zh: 音乐和音效必须在同一空间同时进行表演。

sentences.en: Musical instruments were used to make the effects because they were easy to find and easy to manipulate.
sentences.zh: 乐器被用来制造音效，因为它们容易找到且易于操控。

sentences.en: In this Tom and Jerry clip, the sound of a frying pan hitting Tom's face is played by a cymbal crash.
sentences.zh: 在这段《猫和老鼠》片段中，平底锅砸在汤姆脸上的声音是用镲片撞击声表现的。

sentences.en: And that falling whistle from the beginning of the episode?
sentences.zh: 还有剧集开头那个坠落的哨声？

sentences.en: That's played on a slide whistle.
sentences.zh: 那是用滑音哨吹出来的。

sentences.en: The percussionist would probably have it as part of their kit,
sentences.zh: 打击乐手通常会把它作为乐器包的一部分，

sentences.en: and it was just a natural to convey going up or down.
sentences.zh: 用它来表现上升或下降非常自然。

sentences.en: You could manipulate them in any one of a number of ways, very quickly or very slowly.
sentences.zh: 你可以用多种方式操控它们，或快或慢。

sentences.en: Sound effects played by musical instruments became an iconic part of all cartoons.
sentences.zh: 用乐器演奏音效成为了所有动画片的标志性元素。

sentences.en: Then, new audio technology in the 1930s allowed sound editors to add sound effects after recording the orchestra.
sentences.zh: 后来，20世纪30年代的新音频技术允许音效剪辑师在录制完管弦乐后再添加音效。

sentences.en: They could use any prop to make a sound, but often still chose musical instruments.
sentences.zh: 他们可以使用任何道具来制造声音，但往往还是选择乐器。

sentences.en: And because sound effects and music were tightly linked,
sentences.zh: 由于音效和音乐紧密相连，

sentences.en: they worked together to create unique soundscapes.
sentences.zh: 它们共同创造了独特的音景。

sentences.en: Listen to this audio clip from the very first Bugs Bunny cartoon called Porky's Hair Hunt.
sentences.zh: 听听这段来自第一部兔八哥动画片《波基的狩猎》的音频片段。

sentences.en: In it, you can get an idea of how effects and music can come together.
sentences.zh: 从中你可以了解音效和音乐是如何结合在一起的。

sentences.en: Go get them, Zero.
sentences.zh: 去抓住他们，泽罗。

sentences.en: Get that rabbit.
sentences.zh: 抓住那只兔子。

sentences.en: The sounds for Porky's Hair Hunt were created by an editor named Treg Brown.
sentences.zh: 《波基的狩猎》的音效是由一位名叫特雷格·布朗的剪辑师创作的。

sentences.en: Treg worked on Looney Tunes for decades and created many of the iconic cartoon sounds we still know today.
sentences.zh: 特雷格为《乐一通》工作了几十年，创造了许多我们至今仍熟知的标志性动画音效。

sentences.en: Once we divorced ourselves from the need to record live to picture,
sentences.zh: 一旦我们摆脱了必须现场录音以匹配画面的需求，

sentences.en: Treg had this fundamental understanding of how to decontextualize a sound,
sentences.zh: 特雷格就展现出一种将声音去语境化的基本理解力，

sentences.en: how to take the sound of your finger in a Coke bottle
sentences.zh: 他知道如何把手指伸进可乐瓶的声音，

sentences.en: and make that the sound of the Roadrunner tongue flip.
sentences.zh: 变成歪嘴鸟舌头翻动的声音。

sentences.en: Or why the sound of an inertia starter,
sentences.zh: 或者为什么惯性启动器的声音，

sentences.en: the sound of this motor that makes a biplane engine start,
sentences.zh: 那种让双翼飞机引擎启动的马达声，

sentences.en: why that's the sound of a spinning Tasmanian devil.
sentences.zh: 会成为塔斯马尼亚恶魔旋转的声音。

sentences.en: He learned to be a genius at taking sounds out of one context and placing them in another context.
sentences.zh: 他练就了天才般的本领，能将声音从一个语境中剥离，放入另一个语境中。

sentences.en: And that's what made him so amazing.
sentences.zh: 这就是他如此了不起的原因。

sentences.en: And when you listen to those Looney Tunes shorts, there isn't a lot of cartoon sound in those.
sentences.zh: 当你听那些《乐一通》短片时，里面其实并没有太多的“动画音效”。

sentences.en: There isn't a lot of comedic sound.
sentences.zh: 并没有太多的喜剧音效。

sentences.en: It's all relied on his ability to take a sound from somewhere else and put it where it didn't belong,
sentences.zh: 一切都依赖于他将别处的声音拿来，放在不属于它的地方的能力，

sentences.en: creating this bizarre juxtaposition that made it funny.
sentences.zh: 创造出一种怪异的并置，从而产生幽默感。

sentences.en: And I don't think there was anybody better than he was at that.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有人比他做得更好。

sentences.en: Around the same time Treg was working at Warner Brothers,
sentences.zh: 就在特雷格在华纳兄弟工作的同时，

sentences.en: William Hanna and Joseph Barbera were creating the Tom and Jerry cartoons at MGM.
sentences.zh: 威廉·汉纳和约瑟夫·巴伯拉正在米高梅创作《猫和老鼠》动画片。

sentences.en: Mark's mentor, Greg Watson, was a sound editor on those early Tom and Jerry cartoons.
sentences.zh: 马克的导师格雷格·沃森就是那些早期《猫和老鼠》动画片的音效剪辑师。

sentences.en: When I met him, he was in his 60s, late in his career, but immensely proud to be still working in cartoons.
sentences.zh: 我见到他时，他已经60多岁了，职业生涯已近尾声，但仍为自己能继续从事动画工作而深感自豪。

sentences.en: He still saw it as an art form, something he was very proud of.
sentences.zh: 他依然将其视为一种艺术形式，一种他引以为傲的事业。

sentences.en: And he would never take credit for anything unless I asked him,
sentences.zh: 除非我问他，否则他从不居功，

sentences.en: hey, Greg, where did this come from?
sentences.zh: “嘿，格雷格，这个声音是从哪儿来的？”

sentences.en: And he said, oh, I remember back in, you know, 51 when Bill did this one funny scene with Jerry
sentences.zh: 他会说：“哦，我记得在51年，比尔做了这个有趣的场景，杰瑞在里面，

sentences.en: and we needed a funny sound and we thought it would be good to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个有趣的声音，我们觉得这样做会很好。”

sentences.en: He was a man that was just thrilled to be a part of the process.
sentences.zh: 他是一个仅仅因为能参与这个过程就感到无比激动的人。

sentences.en: Bill Hanna and Joseph Barbera eventually created their own studio.
sentences.zh: 比尔·汉纳和约瑟夫·巴伯拉最终创建了自己的工作室。

sentences.en: And during their 30 years of making cartoons,
sentences.zh: 在他们制作动画片的30年里，

sentences.en: they created a massive library of totally classic sounds.
sentences.zh: 他们建立了一个庞大的经典音效库。

sentences.en: I think they're unique, at least because of their own merit, they're just silly.
sentences.zh: 我认为它们很独特，至少就其本身而言，它们就是很滑稽。

sentences.en: So many of them, even out of the context of the cartoon,
sentences.zh: 其中很多声音，即使脱离了动画片的语境，

sentences.en: just sound like that's just the silliest thing I've ever heard.
sentences.zh: 听起来也像是我听过的最滑稽的东西。

sentences.en: But then within the context of the cartoons and the way that they were used
sentences.zh: 但当它们置于动画片的语境中，配合它们的使用方式，

sentences.en: and the life that they brought to those cartoons,
sentences.zh: 以及它们为动画片注入的生命力，

sentences.en: they just get better basking in the limelight of the animation.
sentences.zh: 它们在动画的聚光灯下显得更加出色。

sentences.en: For instance, this sound is pretty silly on its own.
sentences.zh: 例如，这个声音本身就很滑稽。

sentences.en: Now imagine Tom hanging from his whiskers in the unavoidable fall
sentences.zh: 现在想象一下汤姆挂在胡须上，在不可避免的坠落中，

sentences.en: as each one is plucked from his cheeks.
sentences.zh: 胡须一根根从脸颊上被拔掉。

sentences.en: There were hundreds of familiar sounds like this created at Hanna-Barbera Studios.
sentences.zh: 在汉纳-巴伯拉工作室创作了数百种像这样的熟悉音效。

sentences.en: They had such a signature quality to themselves that
sentences.zh: 它们具有如此鲜明的个人特色，

sentences.en: it made them stand out as a unique piece of quality artwork, sonic artwork.
sentences.zh: 使它们作为独特的艺术作品、声音艺术作品脱颖而出。

sentences.en: In the 1960s, Hanna-Barbera started selling their sound library.
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代，汉纳-巴伯拉开始出售他们的音效库。

sentences.en: Other production companies like Warner Brothers use these sounds to this day.
sentences.zh: 其他制作公司，如华纳兄弟，至今仍在使用这些声音。

sentences.en: The popularity of the Hanna-Barbera sound library has given cartoons an almost universal sound language.
sentences.zh: 汉纳-巴伯拉音效库的流行，赋予了动画片一种近乎通用的声音语言。

sentences.en: But Mark feels some sounds are overused.
sentences.zh: 但马克觉得有些声音被过度使用了。

sentences.en: I was on a one-man campaign to eradicate.
sentences.zh: 我曾发起过一场单人运动，旨在根除它。

sentences.en: Head take.
sentences.zh: “头部猛转”音效。

sentences.en: It was this inane noise that was, again, I think a recording accident
sentences.zh: 这是一种愚蠢的噪音，我再次认为那是一个录音事故，

sentences.en: that you would use whenever a character all of a sudden caught themselves
sentences.zh: 每当角色突然意识到自己

sentences.en: in the midst of thinking or experiencing something bizarre.
sentences.zh: 正在思考或经历某种怪异的事情时，你就会用到它。

sentences.en: And it was way overused.
sentences.zh: 它被过度使用了。

sentences.en: And did you ever notice how it sounds when a cartoon character runs?
sentences.zh: 你有没有注意到动画角色奔跑时的声音？

sentences.en: Mark's not a fan of that one either.
sentences.zh: 马克也不喜欢那个。

sentences.en: That running sound was called blop-gallop.
sentences.zh: 那种奔跑的声音被称为“噗哒-奔跑”。

sentences.en: And again, a sound that was, I felt, overused.
sentences.zh: 同样，我觉得这是一个被过度使用的声音。

sentences.en: And I tried to not use it as often as I could.
sentences.zh: 我尽量少用它。

sentences.en: That's illogical.
sentences.zh: 那是不合逻辑的。

sentences.en: But I tried not to use it as often as possible.
sentences.zh: 但我尽量避免使用它。

sentences.en: It's a testament to its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 这证明了它的有效性。

sentences.en: But even in 1976, I was turning into an elitist, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 但即使在1976年，我想我也开始变得有点精英主义了。

sentences.en: How embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 真尴尬。

sentences.en: Of course, there are plenty of sounds that Mark loves, like a tiptoeing xylophone.
sentences.zh: 当然，马克也有很多钟爱的声音，比如蹑手蹑脚的木琴声。

sentences.en: That's a classic sound.
sentences.zh: 那是一个经典的声音。

sentences.en: I have actually used that sound.
sentences.zh: 我确实用过那个声音。

sentences.en: I did the two Flintstone live-action movies.
sentences.zh: 我制作了两部《摩登原始人》真人电影。

sentences.en: And I did use it in that because that was a sound that Brian Levant, the director, and I just loved.
sentences.zh: 我在里面用了它，因为那是导演布莱恩·莱温特和我非常喜欢的声音。

sentences.en: And we just couldn't avoid using that.
sentences.zh: 我们实在无法抗拒使用它。

sentences.en: My favorite was the Jetson spaceships.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的是杰森一家的宇宙飞船声。

sentences.en: And I never found out what those were made from.
sentences.zh: 我从来没搞清楚它们是用什么做的。

sentences.en: I tried to deconstruct them.
sentences.zh: 我试着拆解过它们。

sentences.en: I asked around the studio if they know who made them and nobody knew.
sentences.zh: 我在工作室到处打听是否有人知道是谁做的，但没人知道。

sentences.en: But that sound always brings a smile to my face.
sentences.zh: 但那个声音总能让我会心一笑。

sentences.en: Sadly, some of these old techniques have been loSt.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，其中一些古老的技术已经失传了。

sentences.en: But remember, this was a busy studio.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，这曾经是一个繁忙的工作室。

sentences.en: And everyone was focused on getting the work done on time and getting cartoons on air.
sentences.zh: 每个人都专注于按时完成工作，让动画片准时播出。

sentences.en: It was a real machine.
sentences.zh: 它就像一台真正的机器。

sentences.en: It always started with track reading.
sentences.zh: 一切总是从音轨解读开始。

sentences.en: This is Ballpoint Puns, line one.
sentences.zh: 这是《圆珠笔双关语》，第一行。

sentences.en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 各位女士，各位先生，晚上好。

sentences.en: Which is to say, the voices would be assembled in a studio with a script and storyboards.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，配音演员会带着剧本和故事板在录音棚里集合。

sentences.en: The director of that show would walk the talent through the recording session
sentences.zh: 该节目的导演会引导演员完成录音过程，

sentences.en: so that you captured all the voices, speaking all the lines that you needed for that particular episode.
sentences.zh: 这样你就能捕捉到所有需要的台词，完成那一集的配音。

sentences.en: Just watch the birdie.
sentences.zh: 盯着那只小鸟看。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Then the animators would go off and then draw the characters doing these things.
sentences.zh: 然后动画师们会去绘制角色做出这些动作的画面。

sentences.en: Then a month later, all the animation would come back in short rolls of completed scenes.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，所有的动画会以短卷的形式送回，成为完成的场景。

sentences.en: Then we in the editorial department would assemble them in their storyboard order
sentences.zh: 然后我们编辑部门会按照故事板的顺序将它们组装起来，

sentences.en: and then cut them down to show length.
sentences.zh: 并剪辑成节目的时长。

sentences.en: There wasn't like animatics in between like we have in live action.
sentences.zh: 不像真人电影那样中间有动态故事板。

sentences.en: We'd assemble a show and then cut sound to it.
sentences.zh: 我们会组装好节目，然后为其配音。

sentences.en: When Mark was working with Hanna-Barbera, they didn't have a department dedicated to creating new sounds.
sentences.zh: 当马克在汉纳-巴伯拉工作时，他们没有专门负责创作新音效的部门。

sentences.en: If he wanted an effect that wasn't in the library, he had to find it himself.
sentences.zh: 如果他想要一个音效库里没有的效果，他就得自己去找。

sentences.en: You were just kind of on your own.
sentences.zh: 你基本上只能靠自己。

sentences.en: I was the most adventurous, especially for the super friends.
sentences.zh: 我是最爱冒险的，尤其是为了《超级朋友》这部片子。

sentences.en: I would go across the hall to talk to the two composers, Paul Decourt and Hoyt Curtin,
sentences.zh: 我会穿过大厅去找两位作曲家，保罗·德库特和霍伊特·柯廷谈话，

sentences.en: and I'd ask them for musical sounds and especially synthesizer sounds.
sentences.zh: 我会向他们索要音乐音效，尤其是合成器音效。

sentences.en: So they would give me long recorded stretches of just weird noises they'd make with their synthesizers.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会给我录制很长一段他们用合成器制作的奇怪噪音。

sentences.en: And they would always be used as the science fiction components.
sentences.zh: 这些音效总是被用作科幻元素。

sentences.en: If I had a spaceship or a flying saucer in an episode, that's what I'd use the electronic sounds for
sentences.zh: 如果我在某一集中有宇宙飞船或飞碟，我就会用这些电子音效，

sentences.en: because that felt futuristic to me.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得那很有未来感。

sentences.en: And if Mark couldn't find the sound he wanted, he had to create it, even if he had to use his own voice.
sentences.zh: 如果马克找不到他想要的音效，他就必须自己创造，哪怕是用自己的声音。

sentences.en: If you can't find it, you do it with your voice.
sentences.zh: 如果你找不到，就用自己的声音来做。

sentences.en: It's the easiest tool to manipulate.
sentences.zh: 这是最容易操控的工具。

sentences.en: You have total control over it.
sentences.zh: 你可以完全掌控它。

sentences.en: I use it for creatures and animals and funny noises.
sentences.zh: 我用它来制作生物、动物和有趣的噪音。

sentences.en: I did a lot of Gremlins voices for the Gremlins movies.
sentences.zh: 我为《小魔怪》电影做了很多小魔怪的配音。

sentences.en: Having fun?
sentences.zh: 玩得开心吗？

sentences.en: Pretty neat, huh?
sentences.zh: 挺酷的，对吧？

sentences.en: What is with you guys?
sentences.zh: 你们这是怎么了？

sentences.en: I've already fed you.
sentences.zh: 我已经喂过你们了。

sentences.en: It's just something where you feel the character inside of yourself and you think,
sentences.zh: 这只是一种感觉，你感受到了角色内心，然后你会想，

sentences.en: I can do this better.
sentences.zh: 我可以做得更好。

sentences.en: And you just do it.
sentences.zh: 然后你就直接去做了。

sentences.en: Mark also went on to work on some of the most classic animated filMs.
sentences.zh: 马克后来还参与了一些最经典的动画电影制作。

sentences.en: I did Beauty and the BeaSt.
sentences.zh: 我参与了《美女与野兽》的制作。

sentences.en: They can sing, they can dance.
sentences.zh: 它们会唱歌，它们会跳舞。

sentences.en: After all, miss, this is France.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，小姐，这里是法国。

sentences.en: Aladdin.
sentences.zh: 《阿拉丁》。

sentences.en: I can show you the world.
sentences.zh: 我可以带你去看世界。

sentences.en: Shining, shimmering, splendid.
sentences.zh: 闪耀、璀璨、辉煌。

sentences.en: And The Lion King.
sentences.zh: 还有《狮子王》。

sentences.en: It's the circle of life.
sentences.zh: 这是生生不息的循环。

sentences.en: Mark's experiences with animated films were different from the grind of televised cartoons.
sentences.zh: 马克在动画电影中的经历与电视动画的枯燥工作不同。

sentences.en: If nothing else, you get much better schedules.
sentences.zh: 至少，你的时间表会好得多。

sentences.en: You usually get the time to design and create something that no one's ever heard before.
sentences.zh: 你通常有时间去设计和创造一些前所未有的东西。

sentences.en: Another sort of unique distinction is that you have the option to create sound first
sentences.zh: 另一个独特的区别是，你可以选择先制作音效，

sentences.en: and then have animation be done to what you did.
sentences.zh: 然后让动画根据你所做的音效来完成。

sentences.en: It's not that often that we get to actually drive the image.
sentences.zh: 我们很少有机会真正去引导画面。

sentences.en: And on the Disney animated films and the Pixar films and the DreamWorks films and others,
sentences.zh: 而在迪士尼动画电影、皮克斯电影、梦工厂电影以及其他作品中，

sentences.en: they're smart enough to know the value of sound and how it can be the inspiration to the artist
sentences.zh: 他们足够聪明，知道音效的价值，以及它如何能激发艺术家的灵感，

sentences.en: to draw something that they might not otherwise have drawn.
sentences.zh: 去画出他们原本可能不会画的东西。

sentences.en: For example, in Beauty and the Beast, Belle's dad was this inventor
sentences.zh: 例如，在《美女与野兽》中，贝儿的父亲是一位发明家，

sentences.en: and he had built that funny axe chopping machine.
sentences.zh: 他制造了那个有趣的劈柴机。

sentences.en: That was a sound that we made before animation.
sentences.zh: 那是我们在动画制作之前就做好的音效。

sentences.en: Let's give it a try.
sentences.zh: 让我们试一试。

sentences.en: That's just pure design.
sentences.zh: 那纯粹是设计。

sentences.en: That's when you get to let your imagination run wild.
sentences.zh: 那是你可以让想象力尽情驰骋的时候。

sentences.en: You can see a picture from a storyboard
sentences.zh: 你可以看到故事板上的图片，

sentences.en: and then you just get to dream up what it might sound like.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以构思它听起来会是什么样。

sentences.en: And that's just gold for a sound designer
sentences.zh: 对于音效设计师来说，这简直是金矿，

sentences.en: when you're sort of allowed to design unfettered.
sentences.zh: 当你被允许不受束缚地进行设计时。

sentences.en: With all the cable channels and streaming services available today,
sentences.zh: 随着如今所有有线频道和流媒体服务的普及，

sentences.en: there's more animation than ever before.
sentences.zh: 动画比以往任何时候都多。

sentences.en: So how does sound design work in modern cartoons
sentences.zh: 那么现代动画中的音效设计是如何运作的，

sentences.en: and which iconic sounds are still used today?
sentences.zh: 哪些标志性的音效至今仍在使用？

sentences.en: We'll get to all of that when 20,000 Hertz on 99% Invisible continues.
sentences.zh: 当《99%隐形》节目中的《20000赫兹》继续播出时，我们将探讨所有这些问题。

sentences.en: If you haven't watched a cartoon in years,
sentences.zh: 如果你多年没看动画片了，

sentences.en: it might surprise you that sounds from decades ago are still being used today.
sentences.zh: 你可能会惊讶地发现，几十年前的音效至今仍在使用。

sentences.en: I use the older sound effects quite a bit still.
sentences.zh: 我仍然经常使用那些旧的音效。

sentences.en: The Hanna-Barbera Library, the Warner Brothers Library,
sentences.zh: 汉纳-巴伯拉音效库、华纳兄弟音效库，

sentences.en: it's still kind of the go-to for certain gags in certain shows.
sentences.zh: 对于某些节目中的某些桥段，它们仍然是首选。

sentences.en: That's Heather Olsen, an Emmy-nominated sound designer for animation.
sentences.zh: 那是希瑟·奥尔森，一位获得艾美奖提名的动画音效设计师。

sentences.en: She works at Advantage Audio.
sentences.zh: 她在Advantage Audio工作。

sentences.en: I'm working on Star vs. the Forces of Evil for Disney XD.
sentences.zh: 我正在为迪士尼XD频道的《星蝶公主》工作。

sentences.en: Literary Hark!
sentences.zh: 文学听着！

sentences.en: Trolls, The Beat Goes On.
sentences.zh: 《魔发精灵：节奏继续》。

sentences.en: DJ the party!
sentences.zh: DJ派对！

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And Spirit Writing Free for Netflix.
sentences.zh: 还有Netflix的《小马王：自由奔跑》。

sentences.en: You'll say hi to me, huh?
sentences.zh: 你会跟我打招呼的，对吧？

sentences.en: I worked on The Fairly Odd Parents.
sentences.zh: 我曾参与《反斗家族》的制作。

sentences.en: Fairly Odd Parents!
sentences.zh: 《反斗家族》！

sentences.en: Tough Puppy.
sentences.zh: 《特工酷狗》。

sentences.en: He's a tough puppy!
sentences.zh: 他是一只酷狗！

sentences.en: Bunsen is a BeaSt.
sentences.zh: 《邦森是只野兽》。

sentences.en: Bunsen is a Beast!
sentences.zh: 《邦森是只野兽》！

sentences.en: Big Goat Banana Cricket for Nickelodeon.
sentences.zh: 尼克儿童频道的《猪山香蕉蟋蟀》。

sentences.en: Get Pitten!
sentences.zh: 被击中了！

sentences.en: I also worked on The Adventures of Puss in Boots for Netflix.
sentences.zh: 我还参与了Netflix的《穿靴子的猫历险记》。

sentences.en: I am Puss in Boots!
sentences.zh: 我是穿靴子的猫！

sentences.en: Gravity Falls for Disney XD.
sentences.zh: 迪士尼XD频道的《怪诞小镇》。

sentences.en: Rest assured, there's a perfectly logical explanation.
sentences.zh: 请放心，这有一个完美的逻辑解释。

sentences.en: And The Boondocks for Sony.
sentences.zh: 还有索尼的《黑人当自强》。

sentences.en: Chuck, Chuck, Chuck, Chuck!
sentences.zh: 查克，查克，查克，查克！

sentences.en: Heather is an expert in modern cartoon sound design.
sentences.zh: 希瑟是现代动画音效设计的专家。

sentences.en: Cartoon sound effects are different from live-action sound effects
sentences.zh: 动画音效与真人电影音效不同，

sentences.en: because with live-action, you start with production sound.
sentences.zh: 因为真人电影是从现场录音开始的。

sentences.en: You're recording a picture, and they're recording the audio at the same time,
sentences.zh: 你在拍摄画面，他们同时在录制音频，

sentences.en: wherever the actors are.
sentences.zh: 无论演员在哪里。

sentences.en: So if they're on a street, you have cars going by.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们在街上，你会有汽车经过的声音。

sentences.en: Whereas in a cartoon, if you're doing a street scene,
sentences.zh: 而在动画中，如果你在做街景，

sentences.en: all I get is dialogue.
sentences.zh: 我得到的只有对白。

sentences.en: It's just the actors who are recorded,
sentences.zh: 只有演员被录制下来，

sentences.en: and I get to start with a blank slate.
sentences.zh: 我可以从一张白纸开始。

sentences.en: I don't have to try to hide production backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 我不必试图掩盖现场背景音。

sentences.en: I get to get the dialogue, and I get to create a world around it.
sentences.zh: 我得到对白，然后我可以在它周围创造一个世界。

sentences.en: But it's kind of the best thing and the worst thing at the same time to work on a cartoon
sentences.zh: 但制作动画片既是最好的事情，也是最糟糕的事情，

sentences.en: because you're not trying to hide anything, but you have nothing to start with.
sentences.zh: 因为你不需要隐藏任何东西，但你没有任何东西可以作为起点。

sentences.en: So in your head, you have to think, what would this sound like?
sentences.zh: 所以你必须在脑海中思考，这听起来会是什么样？

sentences.en: Much like Mark's time at Hanna-Barbera,
sentences.zh: 就像马克在汉纳-巴伯拉的时光一样，

sentences.en: Heather gets a fully animated show and often adds sound effects
sentences.zh: 希瑟会拿到一部完整的动画片，并经常添加音效，

sentences.en: from a ready-made library of sounds.
sentences.zh: 这些音效来自现成的音效库。

sentences.en: This includes many from the Hanna-Barbera and Warner Brothers libraries.
sentences.zh: 这包括许多来自汉纳-巴伯拉和华纳兄弟音效库的音效。

sentences.en: Here are some of her favorites.
sentences.zh: 以下是她最喜欢的一些音效。

sentences.en: It's called the tube-thunk sound effect.
sentences.zh: 它被称为管子撞击音效。

sentences.en: I think everybody knows what this sounds like.
sentences.zh: 我想每个人都知道这听起来是什么样。

sentences.en: Maybe not what it's called, but it's that sound like when a character gets their head
sentences.zh: 也许不知道它叫什么，但就像当一个角色的头

sentences.en: stuck in a jar, you hear that funk.
sentences.zh: 卡在罐子里时，你会听到那种砰的声音。

sentences.en: I love that old sound.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那个旧音效。

sentences.en: It just so clearly conveys, my head is stuck in this jar,
sentences.zh: 它非常清晰地传达出：我的头卡在这个罐子里了，

sentences.en: and it's not coming out again.
sentences.zh: 而且再也出不来了。

sentences.en: And I also love all the old running sounds.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢所有那些旧的奔跑音效。

sentences.en: And I'm using the xylophone blink all the time.
sentences.zh: 我一直在使用木琴闪烁音效。

sentences.en: Those sounds, I think, have just persisted in everybody's mind in every show
sentences.zh: 我认为这些音效已经存在于每个人的脑海中，出现在每一部节目里，

sentences.en: because that's a language that we've started to understand.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一种我们已经开始理解的语言。

sentences.en: So when someone blinks, you kind of expect to hear that xylophone at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以当有人眨眼时，你现在会期待听到那个木琴声。

sentences.en: And of course, Heather uses the falling whistle.
sentences.zh: 当然，希瑟也会使用下落的哨声。

sentences.en: I think in our side effects library, it's called bomb drop, but it's the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我想在我们的音效库里，它叫炸弹投下，但其实是一回事。

sentences.en: I mean, that's another piece of the language that everybody knows.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是每个人都知道的另一种语言片段。

sentences.en: Since some of the shows she works on are more realistic,
sentences.zh: 由于她参与的一些节目更写实，

sentences.en: Heather wants us to hear the sounds of the characters moving around
sentences.zh: 希瑟希望我们听到角色四处走动

sentences.en: and interacting with their world, kind of like a live-action movie.
sentences.zh: 并与他们的世界互动的声音，就像真人电影一样。

sentences.en: The Foley department really brings the show to life.
sentences.zh: 拟音部门确实让节目变得栩栩如生。

sentences.en: They record footsteps, things characters touch, which we call props.
sentences.zh: 他们录制脚步声，角色触摸的东西，我们称之为道具。

sentences.en: They do more of the smaller sounds,
sentences.zh: 他们负责更多细小的声音，

sentences.en: and it's great to have Foley doing that instead of a library
sentences.zh: 有拟音师来做这些而不是使用音效库真是太好了，

sentences.en: because then you're not hearing the same footsteps over and over.
sentences.zh: 因为这样你就不会一遍又一遍地听到同样的脚步声。

sentences.en: They really make it sound more real.
sentences.zh: 他们真的让声音听起来更真实。

sentences.en: And just like in the past, if you can't find a sound, you have to make it.
sentences.zh: 就像过去一样，如果你找不到某种声音，你就必须自己制造它。

sentences.en: One of the stranger things I've actually recorded and done myself for a sound effect
sentences.zh: 我亲自录制并制作过的最奇怪的音效之一，

sentences.en: is we had a bit in Robot and Monster where everyone was in a crowded restaurant,
sentences.zh: 是在《机器人与怪兽》中，当时每个人都在一家拥挤的餐馆里，

sentences.en: so it was supposed to be this crowd of people gagging and grossed out by something.
sentences.zh: 所以那应该是一群人因为某事而感到恶心想吐的声音。

sentences.en: And that's not exactly an effect I had sitting around my library.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不是我资料库里现成的音效。

sentences.en: So I grabbed a bunch of people around the office,
sentences.zh: 所以我找了办公室里的一群人，

sentences.en: and we recorded ourselves gagging in lots of different ways.
sentences.zh: 我们录下了各种各样作呕的声音。

sentences.en: And then I kind of pieced it all together into a crowd.
sentences.zh: 然后我把它们拼凑在一起，做成了一种人群嘈杂的效果。

sentences.en: Sometimes, layering multiple sounds together is the best way to create something new.
sentences.zh: 有时候，将多种声音叠加在一起是创造新事物的最佳方式。

sentences.en: An odd combination that you might not expect, and I did not invent this,
sentences.zh: 这是一种你可能意想不到的奇特组合，而且这并非我的发明，

sentences.en: Animals and Engines is a really great one.
sentences.zh: “动物与引擎”就是一个非常棒的例子。

sentences.en: You put animal roars under engines, growls.
sentences.zh: 你把动物的咆哮声和引擎声、低吼声结合在一起。

sentences.en: It really kind of brings a vehicle to life.
sentences.zh: 这真的能让交通工具变得栩栩如生。

sentences.en: A lot of shows do it, but Star Wars, definitely the TIE Fighters,
sentences.zh: 很多节目都这么做，但《星球大战》里的钛战机绝对是典型，

sentences.en: there's some growls under there as they go by.
sentences.zh: 当它们飞过时，下面确实混入了一些野兽的低吼声。

sentences.en: Have you actually flown one of these four?
sentences.zh: 你真的驾驶过这四种里的其中一种吗？

sentences.en: It's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 那感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: Inspiration.
sentences.zh: 灵感。

sentences.en: Another option Heather has is to take a classic library sound
sentences.zh: 希瑟（Heather）的另一个选择是采用经典的资料库音效，

sentences.en: and change its pitch to make a new effect.
sentences.zh: 然后改变它的音调来制作出一种新的音效。

sentences.en: Take this cartoon boing sound effect.
sentences.zh: 以这个卡通里的“蹦”声为例。

sentences.en: She can pitch that sound up or down.
sentences.zh: 她可以把那个声音调高或调低。

sentences.en: Heather uses a lot of classic, non-literal sounds while working on cartoons.
sentences.zh: 希瑟在制作动画片时经常使用许多经典的非写实音效。

sentences.en: But some modern cartoons are more realistic than slapstick.
sentences.zh: 但一些现代动画片比闹剧更写实。

sentences.en: Her choices really depend on the show.
sentences.zh: 她的选择很大程度上取决于节目本身。

sentences.en: So, especially when we get a new show,
sentences.zh: 所以，特别是当我们接到一个新节目时，

sentences.en: we'll do what we call spotting the show,
sentences.zh: 我们会进行所谓的“定点审片”，

sentences.en: where the clients come in and we watch it together
sentences.zh: 客户会过来，我们一起观看，

sentences.en: and we kind of talk about what they'd like where
sentences.zh: 讨论他们希望在什么地方加入什么声音，

sentences.en: and just the overall feel of the show.
sentences.zh: 以及节目的整体基调。

sentences.en: Like, is it going to be kind of a realistic show, like Spirit,
sentences.zh: 比如，这会是一个像《小马王》（Spirit）那样写实的节目，

sentences.en: or is it going to be really cartoony, like Fairly Oddparents?
sentences.zh: 还是像《反斗家族》（Fairly Oddparents）那样非常卡通化的节目？

sentences.en: Fairly Oddparents taught me how to speak cartoon.
sentences.zh: 《反斗家族》教会了我如何用“卡通语言”交流。

sentences.en: I'm not going near that thing without the appropriate protective gear.
sentences.zh: 没有合适的防护装备，我是绝对不会靠近那东西的。

sentences.en: It's just non-stop cartoon, cartoon, cartoon.
sentences.zh: 那里面全是没完没了的卡通元素。

sentences.en: Where something like Spirit, it feels more like you're making a movie with,
sentences.zh: 而像《小马王》这样的作品，感觉更像是在制作一部电影，

sentences.en: you know, horses out in the fields with the girls.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是关于女孩们在野外骑马的故事。

sentences.en: What's the matter, boy?
sentences.zh: 怎么了，伙计？

sentences.en: Don't you remember me from the train?
sentences.zh: 你不记得我在火车上见过你吗？

sentences.en: Because Spirit Riding Free has more natural sounds
sentences.zh: 因为《小马王：自由奔跑》（Spirit Riding Free）需要更自然的声音，

sentences.en: than a cartoon like Fairly Oddparents,
sentences.zh: 而不像《反斗家族》那样的卡通片，

sentences.en: Heather needed some new sounds.
sentences.zh: 所以希瑟需要一些新的音效。

sentences.en: We got a whole new horse library,
sentences.zh: 我们获得了一个全新的马匹音效库，

sentences.en: because in that show, there's three characters who are horses,
sentences.zh: 因为在那部剧里，有三个角色是马，

sentences.en: so there are no actors voicing them,
sentences.zh: 所以没有演员为它们配音，

sentences.en: and they each have a different personality,
sentences.zh: 而且它们每个人都有不同的个性，

sentences.en: so we had to find kind of different vocals for each of the horses.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须为每一匹马找到不同的声音。

sentences.en: But even Spirit Riding Free still sometimes needs a dose of the vintage cartoon sounds.
sentences.zh: 但即使是《小马王：自由奔跑》，有时也需要一点复古卡通音效的点缀。

sentences.en: A lot of times people will come in with their show and say,
sentences.zh: 很多时候，人们带着他们的节目来找我们，说：

sentences.en: I don't want to use those old Hanna-Barbera sounds,
sentences.zh: “我不想用那些老掉牙的汉纳-巴伯拉（Hanna-Barbera）音效，

sentences.en: I want to do something completely different.
sentences.zh: 我想做点完全不同的东西。”

sentences.en: But they've kind of animated it the traditional way,
sentences.zh: 但他们的动画制作方式比较传统，

sentences.en: so when you put new sounds to that, it just feels wrong,
sentences.zh: 所以当你给它配上新音效时，感觉就是不对劲，

sentences.en: and a lot of times they eventually go back to using the older sound effects.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，他们最终还是会回去使用那些老派的音效。

sentences.en: When it comes to cartoon sound design,
sentences.zh: 谈到卡通音效设计，

sentences.en: Mark and Heather both agree that the medium pushes the boundaries of creativity.
sentences.zh: 马克（Mark）和希瑟都认为这种媒介突破了创造力的界限。

sentences.en: Characters stretch unnaturally out of their body shapes.
sentences.zh: 角色会以不自然的方式拉伸身体。

sentences.en: You know, those are just the simplest examples of visually what's happening with these characters,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些只是这些角色视觉表现上最简单的例子，

sentences.en: so in a way, it gives you permission to break the laws of what sound you should hear when you see something.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，它让你有权打破当你看到某种事物时“应该”听到什么声音的定律。

sentences.en: I really like working for animation because I like to build a world with sound from the ground up.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢为动画工作，因为我喜欢从零开始用声音构建一个世界。

sentences.en: Because in animation, the best part is you're designing a world from nothing,
sentences.zh: 因为在动画中，最棒的部分就是你是在凭空设计一个世界，

sentences.en: a world that no one's ever heard before.
sentences.zh: 一个前所未闻的世界。

sentences.en: And sound design, I think, is a huge part of the process for animation
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，音效设计是动画制作过程中非常重要的一部分，

sentences.en: because there's no sound except the talking.
sentences.zh: 因为除了对白，原本没有任何声音。

sentences.en: So you get to do the backgrounds and the sound effects and the foley,
sentences.zh: 所以你可以负责背景音、音效和拟音，

sentences.en: and I think it all combines to really bring the animation to life.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一切结合起来，真正让动画变得栩栩如生。

sentences.en: So now, there's so many tools that anyone can get their hands on.
sentences.zh: 现在，有太多的工具是任何人都可以接触到的了。

sentences.en: You're really free to design sound in any way your imagination desires.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以自由地按照你想象中的任何方式来设计声音。

sentences.en: It's important for us to follow our hearts.
sentences.zh: 追随内心对我们来说很重要。

sentences.en: When we follow our heart, and then we make a career out of that,
sentences.zh: 当我们追随内心，并以此为职业时，

sentences.en: we make a day-to-day avocation to something,
sentences.zh: 我们将日常工作变成了一种志趣，

sentences.en: that gives all of us purpose, and it allows us to make a contribution to the world.
sentences.zh: 这赋予了我们所有人目标感，也让我们能够为世界做出贡献。

sentences.en: This episode of 20,000 Hertz was written and produced by James Intracasso and Dallas Taylor
sentences.zh: 本期《20,000赫兹》（20,000 Hertz）由詹姆斯·因特拉卡索（James Intracasso）和达拉斯·泰勒（Dallas Taylor）编导，

sentences.en: with help from Sam Schneebly out of the studios of DeFacto Sound.
sentences.zh: 并由DeFacto Sound工作室的萨姆·施内布利（Sam Schneebly）协助制作。

sentences.en: It was edited, sound designed, and mixed by Nick Spradlin.
sentences.zh: 剪辑、音效设计和混音由尼克·斯普拉德林（Nick Spradlin）完成。

sentences.en: All the music in this episode was provided by Musicbed.
sentences.zh: 本集中的所有音乐均由Musicbed提供。

sentences.en: You should subscribe to 20,000 Hertz.
sentences.zh: 你应该订阅《20,000赫兹》。

sentences.en: They're a great indie podcaSt. I'm a big fan.
sentences.zh: 他们是一个很棒的独立播客。我是他们的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: You'll totally dig it.
sentences.zh: 你一定会喜欢的。

sentences.en: We'll have a link on our website and in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 我们会在我们的网站和节目说明中提供链接。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is a project of KALW 91.7 in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 《99%无形》（99% Invisible）是旧金山KALW 91.7电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced on Radio Row in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心美丽的“广播街”（Radio Row）制作。

sentences.en: We are a member of Radiotopia from PRX,
sentences.zh: 我们是PRX旗下Radiotopia的成员，

sentences.en: a fiercely independent collective of the most innovative shows in all of podcasting.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由播客界最具创新性的节目组成的独立联盟。

sentences.en: Find them all at radiotopia.fm.
sentences.zh: 请访问 radiotopia.fm 了解更多。

sentences.en: You can find this show and join discussions about the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到本节目并参与讨论。

sentences.en: You can tweet at me at Roman Mars and the show at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在推特上关注我 @RomanMars，或关注节目 @99pi.org。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram, Tumblr, and Reddit too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在Instagram、Tumblr和Reddit上。

sentences.en: But our forever home on the web is 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 但我们在网络上永远的家是 99pi.org。

sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
